title: 第992章 再见老沈第991章 这不满嘴跑飞舟吗
slug: 开局战五渣我靠空间挂机修仙
content_zh:
道玄真人看到外面虚空中，秦怀安用仙元力形成的文字，不禁脸色微变。
这正是他师尊苍瀚真人留下来的那枚关于阵法的玉简传承。
虽然道玄真人和长风在阵法一道的天赋都只能算一般，但这个玉简他们也都是研读过的。
道玄真人对于玉简开篇的一段话，极为熟悉。
当看到这段话的时候，道玄真人想起当初离开紫荆大陆的师尊。
这么多年，苍瀚真人并未再返回紫荆大陆。当初苍瀚真人离开的时候也只是金仙大圆满修为。一个金仙大圆满，如果没有各大域的舆图，在无边无际的无涯海中，很难找到其他大陆。
而且，一个金仙大圆满修士，在拥有众多仙尊强者的其他大域，也是充满了危险。
现在各大域通往紫荆大陆的虚无通道已经尽皆打开，也不知道师尊能否通过这些通道返回紫荆大陆。道玄真人心中暗暗想着。
“师尊，那真的是师祖的阵法传承玉简！”明泽在看到这些文字后，略显激动的说道。
明泽也看到这个阵法传承玉简，所以他一眼就认了出来。明泽心中想的是，如果真如秦怀安师叔所说，天宝圣地的驻地已经被灭，那他们就不用被困在这个护山大阵之内了。
至于秦怀安能不能灭掉天宝圣地驻地，明泽则是有自己的看法。
根据传言，小师叔在金仙境界就能逃脱天宝圣地仙尊大圆满强者的追杀，现在小师叔已经仙尊大圆满了，只要没有达到大罗金仙境界，哪个仙尊强者能是小师叔的对手？
当初长风师叔在仙尊后期，就轻松斩杀来犯的仙尊大圆满修士。小师叔能灭掉没有大罗金仙坐镇的天宝圣地驻地，很合理吧？
道玄真人真是稳定心神，沉声说道：“不急！”
“如果秦怀安师弟被天宝圣地抓获，他们很容易就能得到这个阵法传承玉简。阵法传承玉简上有你师尊的名号，他们很有可能就会拿这个来诓骗我们。”
虽然他不明白秦怀安如何在短短不到百年时间，就从仙尊初期直接晋级到仙尊大圆满，但道玄真人其实已经有点相信秦怀安了。
不过，他手中的控制阵旗，掌控着整个紫荆圣地的生死，他绝对不会轻易下定论。
道玄真人朝明泽说道：“明泽，你去把沈沧澜带过来。”
“是，师尊！”明泽转身就向着一片建筑群飞去，那是紫荆圣地弟子修炼之地。
当初沈沧澜从九刧问仙塔出来之后，就加入了紫天圣地。这数百年来，他一直在紫天圣地修炼。

真要说起来，道玄真人和秦怀安相处时间并不长，反而是沈沧澜更加了解秦怀安。
就在明泽去带沈沧澜过来的时候，秦怀安已经收齐了苍瀚真人的阵法玉简。
他也仅仅展示了开篇一页的概述，相信道玄真人一定可以认出这个阵法玉简并非作伪。
收起阵法玉简之后，秦怀安想了想，心神微动，一个面具法宝就出现在他的手中。
当秦怀安取出这件面具法宝的时候，穆紫琳目光一凝，就盯着秦怀安手中的千幻面具，微微出神。
她一眼就看出，这就是当初她送给秦怀安的那个面具法宝，当初的秦怀安也只是渡劫期而已。
秦怀安并不知道里面这些人的反应，而是自顾自的说道：“紫琳师侄，还记得这个面具千幻吗。这个面具对于我的帮助颇大，还要多谢紫琳师侄。”
content_en:
Master Daoxuan couldn't help but change his face slightly when he saw the words Qin Huaian formed with his immortal energy in the void outside.
This is exactly the jade slip about the formation left behind by his master, Master Cang Han.
Although Daoxuan Zhenren and Changfeng's talents in formations are only average, they have also studied this jade slip.
Master Daoxuan was very familiar with the opening paragraph of the jade slip.
When he saw this passage, Master Daoxuan thought of his master who had left Bauhinia Continent.
For so many years, Master Canghan has not returned to Bauhinia Continent. When Master Canghan left, he was only at the level of Golden Immortal Dzogchen. A Golden Immortal Dzogchen, without maps of the major domains, it would be difficult to find other continents in the boundless boundless sea.
Moreover, a Golden Immortal Dzogchen cultivator is also full of dangers in other areas where there are many powerful Immortal Masters.
Now all the void passages from all major regions to the Bauhinia Continent have been opened, and it is not known whether Master can return to the Bauhinia Continent through these passages. Master Daoxuan thought secretly in his heart.
"Master, that is really the jade slip of the master's formation inheritance!" Mingze said slightly excitedly after seeing these words.
Mingze also saw this formation inheritance jade slip, so he recognized it at a glance. What Mingze was thinking was that if, as Uncle Qin Huaian said, the Tianbao Holy Land had been destroyed, then they wouldn't have to be trapped in this mountain-protecting formation.
As for whether Qin Huaian can destroy the Tianbao Holy Land station, Mingze has his own opinion.
According to rumors, the young master's uncle can escape the pursuit of the powerful Immortal Master Dzogchen in the Tianbao Holy Land when he is in the Golden Immortal Realm. Now that the young Master's Uncle has reached the Immortal Master Dzogchen, as long as he has not reached the Daluo Golden Immortal realm, which powerful Immortal Master can be his opponent?
When Uncle Changfeng was in the late stage of Immortal Lord, he easily killed the invading Immortal Lord Dzogchen cultivator. Is it reasonable for Junior Master Uncle to destroy the Tianbao Holy Land station where Daluo Jinxian is not in charge?
Master Daoxuan was really calm and said in a deep voice: "No hurry!"
"If Junior Brother Qin Huaian is captured by Tianbao Holy Land, they can easily obtain this formation inheritance jade slip. Your master's name is on the formation inheritance jade slip, and they will most likely use this to deceive us."
Although he didn't understand how Qin Huaian could directly advance from the early stage of Immortal Lord to the Great Perfection of Immortal Lord in less than a hundred years, Master Daoxuan actually already believed in Qin Huaian.
However, the control formation flag in his hand controls the life and death of the entire Bauhinia Holy Land, and he will never make a conclusion easily.
Master Daoxuan said to Mingze: "Mingze, go and bring Shen Canglan over."
"Yes, Master!" Mingze turned around and flew towards a group of buildings, which was the training ground for the disciples of the Bauhinia Holy Land.
After Shen Canglan came out of the Nine Tribulations Wenxian Pagoda, he joined the Purple Sky Holy Land. For hundreds of years, he has been practicing in the Purple Sky Holy Land.
To be honest, Master Daoxuan and Qin Huaian didn't get along for a long time. On the contrary, Shen Canglan knew Qin Huaian better.
Just when Mingze went to bring Shen Canglan over, Qin Huaian had already collected all the formation jade slips of Master Canghan.
He only showed an overview of the first page, and believed that Daoxuan Master would be able to recognize that this formation jade slip was not a forgery.
After putting away the formation jade slip, Qin Huaian thought for a while, his mind moved slightly, and a mask magic weapon appeared in his hand.
When Qin Huaian took out this mask magic weapon, Mu Zilin stared at the Qianhuan Mask in Qin Huaian's hand, slightly lost in thought.
She could tell at a glance that this was the mask magic weapon she had given to Qin Huaian, and Qin Huaian was only in the stage of transcending the tribulation.
Qin Huaian didn't know the reaction of the people inside, but he said to himself: "Senior Nephew Zi Lin, do you still remember this mask Qianhuan? This mask has been of great help to me, and I have to thank Senior Nephew Zi Lin."
